name: hcapp_copyEventRsvps
description: Copies RSVP rows from one event to another: for every live (removed = 0) HC.HasherEventMap row of @fromEvent whose hasher has NO row for @toEvent, inserts a new row carrying RsvpState, IsHare and VirginVisitorType (AttendenceState is not copied). Used by run admins to pre-populate a rescheduled run. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 21, standard token). @fromEvent and @toEvent required (both 1221 / errorType 12). Inside the transaction: both events must exist and belong to the same kennel (1221 / 12, after ROLLBACK), and the caller must hold HC6.CheckKennelPermission 'copyRsvps' for that kennel (1321 / 13, after ROLLBACK). On success returns the envelope, an adHocData row { adHocDataId = 1, serverMessage = 'Copied N RSVPs' } and then HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData's rowsets for @toEvent with only the HasherEventMap watermark live.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to ValidateAppAuth for authentication.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived cryptographic token validated against DeviceSecret by ValidateAppAuth.

parameters.name: fromEvent
parameters.description: Source event UUID. RSVPs are copied from this event. Validated as non-null and non-zero-UUID before the transaction.

parameters.name: toEvent
parameters.description: Target event UUID. RSVPs are copied into this event. Validated as non-null and non-zero-UUID before the transaction.

parameters.name: hasherEventMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync watermark forwarded to hcapp_syncEventAdminData for the HasherEventMap rowset; NULL → 'ignore'. NO SQL DEFAULT — the client must pass it (NULL is fine, omission is not).

rowsets.name: WriteEnvelope
rowsets.description: Success/failure envelope returned on all paths. On any auth or validation error this is followed immediately by rowset 1 containing error detail.

columns.name: success
columns.description: 1 on success, 0 on any auth, validation, or database error.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: NULL on success. 1221 null fromEvent, null toEvent, or events not in one kennel (all three); 1321 not authorised; 1921 unhandled; ValidateAppAuth 1121 (invalid token) / 1321 (device not registered — same number as not-authorised) / 1221 (signed out — same number as validation).

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: NULL on success. 1/3/7 auth; 12 validation; 13 not authorised; 19 unhandled.

rowsets.name: AdHocCopyResult
rowsets.description: Returned on success only. Single row confirming how many RSVPs were copied.

columns.name: adHocDataId
columns.description: Always 1. Identifies this as an ad-hoc result row for the caller.

columns.name: serverMessage
columns.description: 'Copied N RSVPs' where N is @@ROWCOUNT from the INSERT INTO HasherEventMap.

rowsets.name: ErrorDetail
rowsets.description: Rowset 1 on any failure after auth, and on auth failure (instead of AdHocCopyResult).

columns.name: errorId
columns.description: UUID of the HC.ErrorLog row written for this error.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Error class code. Matches errorType in the WriteEnvelope rowset.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Numeric error code. Matches errorCode in the WriteEnvelope rowset.

columns.name: errorProc
columns.description: Name of the SP that raised the error. Set via OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID).

rowsets.name: SyncEventAdminData (rowsets 2+)
rowsets.description: On success, after rowset 1, HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData is called for @toEvent. That SP emits multiple result sets (HasherEventMap rows, Hasher rows, etc.). All other sync watermarks are passed as 'ignore'; only hasherEventMapUpdatedAfter is forwarded from the caller.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.HasherEventMap (id = NEWID(), EventId = @toEvent, KennelId, UserId, RsvpState, IsHare, VirginVisitorType, updatedAt = GETDATE()) for each source hasher without a target row — inside the transaction; updatedAtBias from the column default.
EXEC HC6.CheckKennelPermission 'copyRsvps' for the source kennel — inside the transaction.
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on 1221 (three conditions), 1321 and in the CATCH — the in-transaction ones ROLLBACK first so the row survives.
EXEC HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData for @toEvent — after COMMIT, outside TRY/CATCH.

codeSmells.detail: @deviceId, @accessToken, @fromEvent, @toEvent, @hasherEventMapUpdatedAfter (lines 3-7) have no SQL default. A client that omits any of them is refused by SQL BEFORE the procedure runs: no HC.ErrorLog row, an empty 500 in the app, and the SP's own graceful checks are unreachable (CLAUDE.md, Rack of Lamb 2026-09-29). The 1221 checks cover NULL values only.

codeSmells.issue: Same errorCode for two distinct validation errors
codeSmells.detail: Lines 78, 91 and 114: null fromEvent, null toEvent and 'events not in the same kennel' all use errorCode 1221. The three are distinct failures; only errorTitle tells them apart.

codeSmells.issue: Sync delegation outside transaction is undocumented in error paths
codeSmells.detail: Lines 188-205: EXEC HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData runs after COMMIT and outside TRY/CATCH. The envelope and adHocData row have already been sent as success, so a failure inside the sync SP reaches the client as a raw error after a success envelope.
Lines 144-161: the INSERT does not supply updatedAtBias; the column default generates it. Functionally correct, inconsistent with SPs that set it explicitly.

codeSmells.issue: errorCode values collide with ValidateAppAuth codes
codeSmells.detail: 1221 (validation, lines 78/91/114) equals ValidateAppAuth's signed-out code 1200 + 21, and 1321 (not authorised, line 131) equals its device-not-registered code 1300 + 21; only errorType distinguishes them.

breakingChanges: TRY/CATCH and transaction added — HC5 had neither. The INSERT was previously unprotected; it is now atomic.
Success envelope rowset (WriteEnvelope) added as rowset 0 on all code paths — HC5 had no envelope.
Auth now uses HC6.ValidateAppAuth — HC5 used a different authentication mechanism.
Delegation target updated from HC5.hcapp_syncEventAdminData to HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData.

Error detail rowset structure changed — HC5 used the portal StandardErrorResult shape; HC6 uses the app error detail shape with the same columns but different errorType codes (HC6 app codes: 11=auth, 12=param, 19=db).
